text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"On full display at the Arima is
Nakayama
Racecourse's trademark..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, "trademark"? Like that little "r" in
the circle
thingy?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it has another meaning! Huh, learn
something
new every day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... I'm just too dumb, huh?
Seriously...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If only I could understand all your
strategies,
maybe I'd be a stronger
runner.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I did good in the Copa Republica
Argentina. I can
do this too! I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
All right, Jordan cheer squad! Let's hear
it!

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, look at them over there, all
excited.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I don't know if I could survive embarrassing myself in front of them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, just gotta do my best! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know. I actually read up on the course,
I'll have
you know. Plus, you saw how I
ran last time, didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I got this!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the year-end dream race at

Nakayama. Who will it be shining atop
the throne
of this year's grand prix?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I really can do it. I've come this
far,
haven't I?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Step, step, step...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed with fans barely
able to
wait for the race, a contest of
runners heralded as
the strongest of the
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Step, step, step...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They'll be making their way to the
paddock soon!
Let's give them a warm
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Get it, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! I see you! Thanks for coming!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Now that I think about it, the Satsuki
Sho is a G1
race too, isn't it? And it's
not like this is my first
time going up
against seniors...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here they are! They're finally here! The
strongest
Umamusume of the generation
are here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Wha?! Ow, my ears...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Unmatched in the mile, and here to show
us even
more miracles... it's Fuji Kiseki
the entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful flower in bloom, with the
pride of her
blood on the line! It's Air
Groove!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully she makes it out of the gate
safely this
year. Could she be the one to
defeat the front
runner? It's Zenno Rob
Roy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh. "The Umamusume to Watch This
Arima
Kinen!" Okay, why did they have
to make the
picture so huge? Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Air Groove. And Fuji. Ooh, and
Rob Roy's
racewear is so cute.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But like, I've seen all of them. I mean,
obviously.
We go to the same school.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, I've seen them train, way more than
whoever
wrote this has. Well, I guess
that's magazines for
you. Always
overhyping things.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Who are they?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They're nothing like the girls at school I
know.
Where did that... that aura come
from?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will we be taken on a dream journey, or
whisked
away to an unseen vista? Who
will be hailed as
the strongest runner of
all?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here come Mejiro McQueen and Special
Week!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: They look... invincible...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I don't understand. Why are my legs
shaking?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get it, I don't get it. I don't get
it, I don't
get it, I don't get it!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I have no choice! I want to win!
